addValueP: Our calls against just holding the Nifty, and against a watchlist with equal money in each stock. A year a share.
addValueSay: Yes, ahead of both. The gap is small enough that we keep watching it.
analyseLeft: About {m} minutes left. It usually takes {u}.
analyseNote: Uses public data only. Nothing about what we hold is sent. English and Bengali are written together.
avgGapP: points ahead, across all scored calls.
beatP: of scored calls beat the Nifty after 3 months.
bookedP: Gains already booked by selling this tax year.
bySector: Share of the portfolio, by sector
byStock: Share of the portfolio, by stock
calibration: Does our chance match what happened?
callNoneP: No stock needs you. The next look is tomorrow morning.
cashSoon: Cash expected in the next 90 days
cashSoonP: Dividends on shares we hold. Dates can move.
confidence: Our last {n} calls like this: {b} beat the Nifty.
divSub: Dividends paid so far and the ones coming.
every15: News is read every 15 minutes. Filings rank above wire stories, wire above blogs.
exposure: What the news means for us
exposureP: Direction × size × how much we hold. Plus is good for us, minus is bad.
fillsGap: Fills a gap: you hold little in {s}.
findAny: Look up any other stock (typos are fine)
flagsP: Finished code can ship switched off, then go live with one tap.
fundNote.add: Add a little each month. It has been steady in every fall.
fundNote.keep: Keep it. It still beats the middle fund of its kind and costs little.
fundNote.review: Look at it when you can. It has fallen behind its kind for two quarters.
fundNoteP: One short note on each fund we hold or watch, every week.
funnelT: How we got to this list
harvestLine: Selling {n} books a loss of {l} and could save about {s} in tax.
harvestNone: No holding is at a loss, so there is nothing to harvest.
harvestP: Selling a loser books its loss, which cancels tax on gains. Ideas only: nothing is sold for you.
holdSub: What you own, what it is worth, and what we think of each. Pick a source to narrow it.
howOrder: How the order is worked out
layout: Layout: the menu on the left
layoutP: Move a screen up or down, or hide it. It changes at once, with no new release.
layoutSaved: Saved. The menu changes at once.
marketLine: The market looks steady. Banks lead; cement and textiles are weak.
missesP: A short note on each call that missed at its 3-month score. Tap one to read it.
moneyP: The most we suggest you put into new buys this month.
niftyDownP: We might lose about {p}% of the portfolio. A guess from how each stock moved with the Nifty before.
noNews: Nothing in the news about this stock.
notHeld: We do not hold this stock.
noteBody: Banks are over four times their target, and most of that is one stock. Nothing is urgent, but the next buy should go somewhere else.
noteT: Last night's note on the portfolio
noteWhen: Written at 02:10. A longer note comes on Saturday.
o2: Whether you hold a stock it touches
o3: A company filing, or many sources
o5: Touches a stock we have a Buy or Sell on
ovHigh: More than a quarter of this fund is in shares we already hold. Buying it would double up.
ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
packP: Everything your tax return needs, in one file, built from the trades and documents.
pauseKindP: Stops one bad job without stopping the others. The page keeps showing the last good data.
pausedOff: Releases are running. A change that passes every check goes live by itself.
pausedOn: Releases are paused. Nothing new goes live until you switch this off.
pickRow: Pick a row from the list.
rawNeeds: Prices and volume only for now. Yearly company figures arrive with the facts feed.
rawP: Every trading day, as the exchange reported it. The chart is for the shape; this is for the exact figure.
recomputeP: After a formula change, redo the last N days of one dataset. Safe to repeat.
recordP: Every call we made, scored against the Nifty three months later. Good or bad, it shows here.
retSub: How the portfolio did a year, set against the Nifty.
riskSub: How much sits in one place, and what a fall of the Nifty would do.
rsuPrice: US price 112.40 dollars at 84.20 rupees to the dollar. Updated 09:30.
rsuSub: Shares from your employer: what is held, what vests next, and the tax on selling.
rsuTaxP: Estimated tax on the profit above if all of it were sold today.
scVerdict: Our own trades did better by 3.5 points a year. The Smallcase route was steadier but gave up some return.
scopeNote: Totals, tax and mix follow this choice.
settingsP: The few numbers that are yours to set. Our calls never change because of them.
similarP: Close to this one in size and strength. Tap one to look.
stMixP: How you would like the portfolio split across sectors. Portfolio shows where you stand against it.
stMoneyP: How much is left to put in this month, and the amount you set aside each month.
steady: Steady. 64% of stocks are above their 10-month average.
tableHint: Use Table to filter by P/E, growth or chance.
taxDueP: Nothing to pay yet: the gains are inside the tax-free room.
taxSub: What you have booked this year, what is left tax free, and where a loss could help.
verdictLine.buy: Our forecast is good. A fair place to buy a little.
verdictLine.sell: We think this will do worse than the Nifty, or the reason to own it has gone.
verdictLine.watch: Not a buy yet. Close enough to keep an eye on.
verdictLine.weak: Our forecast is low but nothing has broken. Worth a look, no hurry.
watchEmpty: Nothing on the watchlist yet. Type a stock above, or tap a star anywhere.
watchOutP: Stocks with a reason to look again, but not a buy yet.
wlFlagP: Sell or weak calls on the list
xirrP: Counts when each rupee went in, not only how much.
xirrSame: If every rupee had gone into the Nifty on the same days.
